name: env-cap-example-application
description: Minimal end-to-end example: capability-owned env.schema.ts files, a generated contract, and validateEnv() at startup.

scripts.docs: env-cap --include src/env.ts --location src/generated/env.manifest.ts --docs docs/ENVIRONMENT.md --env-example .env.example --env-example-on-existing overwrite --ownership docs/OWNERSHIP.md --evidence docs/env.evidence.json
scripts.check: env-cap --include src/env.ts --location src/generated/env.manifest.ts --docs docs/ENVIRONMENT.md --env-example .env.example --ownership docs/OWNERSHIP.md --evidence docs/env.evidence.json --check
